definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese art of preparing and serving matcha tea.

examples.japanese: {茶道|ちゃどう}を{習|なら}っている。
{茶道|ちゃどう}には{作法|さほう}がたくさんある。
examples.english: Tea ceremony has many rules of etiquette.

examples.japanese: {茶道|ちゃどう}を{体験|たいけん}した。

notes:
{茶道|ちゃどう} is the Japanese tea ceremony.

ALTERNATIVE READING:
- {茶道|さどう}: another reading of the same word

RELATED TERMS:
- {抹茶|まっちゃ}: matcha tea
- {茶室|ちゃしつ}: tea room
- {茶碗|ちゃわん}: tea bowl
- {作法|さほう}: etiquette

SCHOOLS:
- {表千家|おもてせんけ}: Omotesenke school
- {裏千家|うらせんけ}: Urasenke school
